Exact orientation dependence despite isotropic coordinates, a sharp crossing against the rotationally invariant Gaussian baseline for all power counts, and unavoidable discrete zero-overlap directions provide a motivated, complete finite-dimensional performance benchmark. The all-q phase diagram gives precise power sensitivity, not just a trivial instance of a known generic error bound. No broad algorithm superiority is claimed.
